name: DKCTF Hard Mode – direct P2 selector
notes: In-game-confirmed Try 6 selector only. UIPak(21) already passes chooseKongP2.currentState as the third initLevelTransition argument. The native parser reads entries+0x20, maps selector 0..4 to internal Kong IDs, writes state+0x269C, and disables the automatic DK/default P2 store. Try 7 and Try 8 return-restore changes in UpdateCharacterTypes failed for manual level quit and are excluded.

entries.description: Preserve the confirmed independent-P2 Hard Mode state.
Do not overwrite the P2 ID written by initLevelTransition with the automatic DK/default partner.
Preserve the active P2 slot bit during Hard Mode initialization.
For a missing first argument, retain the original w21=0 fallback before entering the compact parser.
Parse the existing third initLevelTransition argument, map the Hard Mode P2 slider, and write state+0x269C.
